key_insight: EviDTB predicts DFT Hamiltonians and their uncertainty in a single forward pass, enabling uncertainty-guided materials screening.
engineering_relevance: Uncertainty scores help prioritize materials for costly first-principles verification while retaining fast electronic-structure predictions.
method: Apply evidential deep regression to tight-binding DFT Hamiltonian prediction.
Estimate prediction uncertainty alongside Hamiltonian matrix elements.
Benchmark against deep ensembles, Monte Carlo dropout, and mean-variance estimation.
evidence_signal: On 5,478 held-out structures, EviDTB achieves 0.622 meV full-SOC Hamiltonian matrix-element MAE and uncertainty–error Spearman ρ = 0.812; excluding the 15% most uncertain structures lowers the 99th-percentile local squared error by 78%.
watch_item: Performance on held-out structures does not establish uncertainty reliability for unfamiliar chemistries or structural regimes.
paper_title: Evidential Deep Regression for Universal Density Functional Theory Hamiltonian Models
